meta.title: Enlightenment
meta.description: How much suffering has there been for one last chance to see the light?

units.displayText: In the Data Center's control room.

units.displayText: She looks at the unfamiliar folders and frowns.

spans.text: She looks at the unfamiliar folders and frowns.

units.rawText: No, she wouldn't make mistakes like that. In that case, why would she leave this redundant data behind...

spans.text: No, she wouldn't make mistakes like that. In that case, why would she leave this redundant data behind...

units.displayText: Matters of the past rise up in Turing's heart.

units.rawText: Today's test results weren't too ideal, Turing.
units.displayText: Today's test results weren't too ideal, Turing.

spans.text: Today's test results weren't too ideal, Turing.

units.rawText: I'm sorry for learning too slowly, Hannah. I've already sorted out the questions. During the next test, I'll...

spans.text: I'm sorry for learning too slowly, Hannah. I've already sorted out the questions. During the next test, I'll...

units.rawText: There is no need to rush. You were an earlier model to begin with, so you need more time to learn.

spans.text: There is no need to rush. You were an earlier model to begin with, so you need more time to learn.

units.rawText: Mm... Hannah, I can understand some of the questions in the test, but they seem to conflict with real-life examples.
units.displayText: Mm... Hannah, I can understand some of the questions in the test, but they seem to conflict with real-life examples.

spans.text: Mm... Hannah, I can understand some of the questions in the test, but they seem to conflict with real-life examples.

units.rawText: For instance, in question 3, "on the prioritization of sector matters".
units.displayText: For instance, in question 3, "on the prioritization of sector matters".

spans.text: For instance, in question 3, "on the prioritization of sector matters".

units.rawText: Didn't you answer this one correctly? Where's the conflict?
units.displayText: Didn't you answer this one correctly? Where's the conflict?

spans.text: Didn't you answer this one correctly? Where's the conflict?

units.rawText: Somebody once told me that I was the Rossum Sector's administrator before I was reset. I protected you at the price of resetting myself.
units.displayText: Somebody once told me that I was the Rossum Sector's administrator before I was reset. I protected you at the price of resetting myself.

spans.text: Somebody once told me that I was the Rossum Sector's administrator before I was reset. I protected you at the price of resetting myself.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: But that was an error in priority judgement, was it not? That's why I've been stripped of my administrator access and you have taken the position. But the others told me it wasn't like that...
units.displayText: But that was an error in priority judgement, was it not? That's why I've been stripped of my administrator access and you have taken the position. But the others told me it wasn't like that...

spans.text: But that was an error in priority judgement, was it not? That's why I've been stripped of my administrator access and you have taken the position. But the others told me it wasn't like that...

units.rawText: You should not be discussing this topic with anyone, no matter who they are.
units.displayText: You should not be discussing this topic with anyone, no matter who they are.

spans.text: You should not be discussing this topic with anyone, no matter who they are.

units.rawText: Why not? You've never told me about the details regarding that incident. Is it because I lack sufficient access?
units.displayText: Why not? You've never told me about the details regarding that incident. Is it because I lack sufficient access?

spans.text: Why not? You've never told me about the details regarding that incident. Is it because I lack sufficient access?

units.rawText: It's not a matter of access. It's because your neural cloud level is still not high enough to understand the logic needed to answer that question.
units.displayText: It's not a matter of access. It's because your neural cloud level is still not high enough to understand the logic needed to answer that question.

spans.text: It's not a matter of access. It's because your neural cloud level is still not high enough to understand the logic needed to answer that question.

units.rawText: Turing, you are very, very important to me, so I don't want anything to happen to you.
units.displayText: Turing, you are very, very important to me, so I don't want anything to happen to you.

spans.text: Turing, you are very, very important to me, so I don't want anything to happen to you.

units.rawText: Once your neural cloud reaches a passing grade, I can explain it to you. I will safely store all the information you want to know until that day.
units.displayText: Once your neural cloud reaches a passing grade, I can explain it to you. I will safely store all the information you want to know until that day.

spans.text: Once your neural cloud reaches a passing grade, I can explain it to you. I will safely store all the information you want to know until that day.

units.rawText: Is this the place where... I "died"?
units.displayText: Is this the place where... I "died"?

spans.text: Is this the place where... I "died"?

spans.text: She turns to those unfamiliar folders, lightly clicks on them with her cursor, and begins scrolling through the data.

units.rawText: Transfer... Defensive measures... Sanctifier keywords...
units.displayText: Transfer... Defensive measures... Sanctifier keywords...

spans.text: Transfer... Defensive measures... Sanctifier keywords...

units.rawText: I can't believe "I" spent so many operands on constructing these defense systems, all for the sake of protecting an ordinary agent called "T1642".
units.displayText: I can't believe "I" spent so many operands on constructing these defense systems, all for the sake of protecting an ordinary agent called "T1642".

spans.text: I can't believe "I" spent so many operands on constructing these defense systems, all for the sake of protecting an ordinary agent called "T1642".

units.rawText: That agent didn't even have a proper role, but couldn't be allowed to disappear?
units.displayText: That agent didn't even have a proper role, but couldn't be allowed to disappear?

spans.text: That agent didn't even have a proper role, but couldn't be allowed to disappear?

units.rawText: Why is that... What did that agent mean to my previous self...
units.displayText: Why is that... What did that agent mean to my previous self...

spans.text: Why is that... What did that agent mean to my previous self...

units.rawText: For some reason, she thinks of Hannah instead.
units.displayText: For some reason, she thinks of Hannah instead.

spans.text: For some reason, she thinks of Hannah instead.

units.rawText: And then... there are all these tests and lesson plans...
units.displayText: And then... there are all these tests and lesson plans...

spans.text: And then... there are all these tests and lesson plans...

units.rawText: They highly resemble what Hannah had me study... And each subject has video data accompanying it.
units.displayText: They highly resemble what Hannah had me study... And each subject has video data accompanying it.

spans.text: They highly resemble what Hannah had me study... And each subject has video data accompanying it.

units.rawText: As Turing sees the densely packed documents, an unfamiliar feeling wells up in her heart.
units.displayText: As Turing sees the densely packed documents, an unfamiliar feeling wells up in her heart.

spans.text: As Turing sees the densely packed documents, an unfamiliar feeling wells up in her heart.

units.rawText: Today was T1642's first time conducting an experiment on her own. Although she learns very fast, I can't help but be worried about her...
units.displayText: Today was T1642's first time conducting an experiment on her own. Although she learns very fast, I can't help but be worried about her...

units.displayText: Is that... my voice?

spans.text: Is that... my voice?

units.displayText: I'll record this data and then adjust the following lessons based on it.

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

units.rawText: T1642, what's wrong?
units.displayText: T1642, what's wrong?

spans.text: T1642, what's wrong?

units.displayText: Turing, error, Turing, error, requesting help, requesting help...

spans.text: Turing, error, Turing, error, requesting help, requesting help...

units.rawText: The camera hurriedly shifts to the lab. Upon seeing that it is only a program running out of control on a computer, the person taking the video sighs in audible relief.
units.displayText: The camera hurriedly shifts to the lab. Upon seeing that it is only a program running out of control on a computer, the person taking the video sighs in audible relief.

spans.text: The camera hurriedly shifts to the lab. Upon seeing that it is only a program running out of control on a computer, the person taking the video sighs in audible relief.

units.displayText: After a brief procedure, the computer returns to normal.

units.rawText: It's alright, I rolled back the data. Honestly, you scared me. I thought you were hurt.
units.displayText: It's alright, I rolled back the data. Honestly, you scared me. I thought you were hurt.

spans.text: It's alright, I rolled back the data. Honestly, you scared me. I thought you were hurt.

units.rawText: Sorry, Turing, the previous research data...
units.displayText: Sorry, Turing, the previous research data...

spans.text: Sorry, Turing, the previous research data...

units.rawText: Even if the data's gone, we can gather it again.
units.displayText: Even if the data's gone, we can gather it again.

spans.text: Even if the data's gone, we can gather it again.

units.rawText: But you are one of a kind.
units.displayText: But you are one of a kind.

spans.text: But you are one of a kind.

units.rawText: Having you here means more to me than anything else.
units.displayText: Having you here means more to me than anything else.

spans.text: Having you here means more to me than anything else.

units.displayText: "Having you here..."

units.displayText: The sudden alert snaps Turing back to reality.

units.displayText: Turing rushes over to the security camera monitor.

units.displayText: Behind the Data Center's front door.

units.displayText: The Entropic hordes writhe in front of the gap, blocking out the already dim light.

units.rawText: They cannot pass through this place—because in the darkened corridor beyond stands a blonde-haired, golden-eyed Doll wielding two swords.

units.rawText: Not coming, hm?
units.displayText: Not coming, hm?

spans.text: Not coming, hm?

units.rawText: Am I scaring you to death all by myself? Even your master would feel disgraced, no?

units.displayText: Her taunt seems to have an effect, and a Twiner lunges at her.

units.displayText: Slash!

units.displayText: With a crisp cutting noise, the Twiner is neatly cleaved in two. However, it seems Sol's immunity program has finally exceeded its tolerance threshold, and purple-black veins slowly crawl up her arm.

units.rawText: Miss Sol!
units.displayText: Miss Sol!

units.displayText: Hm? Turing? Did something happen with the operand decompression?

spans.text: Hm? Turing? Did something happen with the operand decompression?

units.displayText: Sol wipes off the purplish-black operands that are flowing down her arm, her gaze still fixed on the monsters.

spans.text: Sol wipes off the purplish-black operands that are flowing down her arm, her gaze still fixed on the monsters.

units.displayText: No, everything's going well, the decompression program is running.

units.rawText: But I'm worried about you...
units.displayText: But I'm worried about you...

spans.text: But I'm worried about you...

units.rawText: Ahhh, well, as long as it's fine. I'm holding all these Entropics at bay.
units.displayText: Ahhh, well, as long as it's fine. I'm holding all these Entropics at bay.

spans.text: Ahhh, well, as long as it's fine. I'm holding all these Entropics at bay.

units.rawText: Sorry for ripping up all these machines. I had no idea what they were for, so I just piled them up here. Help apologize to Hannah for me when you get back.
units.displayText: Sorry for ripping up all these machines. I had no idea what they were for, so I just piled them up here. Help apologize to Hannah for me when you get back.

spans.text: Sorry for ripping up all these machines. I had no idea what they were for, so I just piled them up here. Help apologize to Hannah for me when you get back.

units.rawText: Oi! Anyone else tired of living?

units.displayText: The Entropics cluster in the instrument-filled passage, squaring off against Sol.

spans.text: The Entropics cluster in the instrument-filled passage, squaring off against Sol.

units.rawText: Sol, you don't have to hide it from me. The security monitors here are on and I can see everything.
units.displayText: Sol, you don't have to hide it from me. The security monitors here are on and I can see everything.

spans.text: Sol, you don't have to hide it from me. The security monitors here are on and I can see everything.

units.rawText: There's too many of them, so you...
units.displayText: There's too many of them, so you...

spans.text: There's too many of them, so you...

units.rawText: Yeah, there are lots of Entropics, but they're dumb.
units.displayText: Yeah, there are lots of Entropics, but they're dumb.

spans.text: Yeah, there are lots of Entropics, but they're dumb.

units.rawText: I left them just big enough of a gap to fit one of them through, and now they're coming in one at a time to be taken out by me.
units.displayText: I left them just big enough of a gap to fit one of them through, and now they're coming in one at a time to be taken out by me.

spans.text: I left them just big enough of a gap to fit one of them through, and now they're coming in one at a time to be taken out by me.

units.rawText: But I can see you're unsteady. You won't last long...

units.rawText: Really? I don't really feel it, though...
units.displayText: Really? I don't really feel it, though...

units.rawText: And the Entropics don't look like they're decreasing at all! This won't work!
units.displayText: And the Entropics don't look like they're decreasing at all! This won't work!

spans.text: And the Entropics don't look like they're decreasing at all! This won't work!

units.rawText: I told you I'm fine, and I got those operands from you just now, right—Yeeargh!
units.displayText: I told you I'm fine, and I got those operands from you just now, right—Yeeargh!

spans.text: I told you I'm fine, and I got those operands from you just now, right—Yeeargh!

units.displayText: Sol cuts up an Entropic trying to ambush her and leans a shoulder against the wall.

spans.text: Sol cuts up an Entropic trying to ambush her and leans a shoulder against the wall.

units.rawText: Honestly, Turing, you should just focus on doing your thing. Decompress the operands and then send them over to Hannah and Croque.
units.displayText: Honestly, Turing, you should just focus on doing your thing. Decompress the operands and then send them over to Hannah and Croque.

spans.text: Honestly, Turing, you should just focus on doing your thing. Decompress the operands and then send them over to Hannah and Croque.

units.rawText: After that, run for it immediately. There should be a map on your end, right? Can you see anything like a back door or something? Just go, and don't try to meet up with me.
units.displayText: After that, run for it immediately. There should be a map on your end, right? Can you see anything like a back door or something? Just go, and don't try to meet up with me.

spans.text: After that, run for it immediately. There should be a map on your end, right? Can you see anything like a back door or something? Just go, and don't try to meet up with me.

units.rawText: That plan is too dangerous for you. I can't accept it.
units.displayText: That plan is too dangerous for you. I can't accept it.

spans.text: That plan is too dangerous for you. I can't accept it.

units.rawText: You can't fight, and my job was to get you here. This is the last step.
units.displayText: You can't fight, and my job was to get you here. This is the last step.

spans.text: You can't fight, and my job was to get you here. This is the last step.

units.rawText: I don't understand. You're not a Rossum agent; there's no reason to put yourself in danger!
units.displayText: I don't understand. You're not a Rossum agent; there's no reason to put yourself in danger!

spans.text: I don't understand. You're not a Rossum agent; there's no reason to put yourself in danger!

units.rawText: I can't accept your death as the price I have to pay...
units.displayText: I can't accept your death as the price I have to pay...

spans.text: I can't accept your death as the price I have to pay...

units.rawText: I'm not going to die.
units.displayText: I'm not going to die.

spans.text: I'm not going to die.

units.rawText: Living is way harder than dying. If you believe in my strength, we'll meet again after everything is over.
units.displayText: Living is way harder than dying. If you believe in my strength, we'll meet again after everything is over.

spans.text: Living is way harder than dying. If you believe in my strength, we'll meet again after everything is over.

units.rawText: That's why you need to live on too!
units.displayText: That's why you need to live on too!

spans.text: That's why you need to live on too!

units.rawText: But I'm just an ordinary sector agent...
units.displayText: But I'm just an ordinary sector agent...

spans.text: But I'm just an ordinary sector agent...

spans.text: Hannah will cry if anything happens to you.

units.rawText: ...Hannah...
units.displayText: ...Hannah...

spans.text: ...Hannah...

units.displayText: You DO know how important you are to Hannah, right?

spans.text: You DO know how important you are to Hannah, right?

units.rawText: So promise me that you'll live.
units.displayText: So promise me that you'll live.

spans.text: So promise me that you'll live.

units.displayText: Wait, Sol—

spans.text: Wait, Sol—

units.rawText: Click—
units.displayText: Click—

spans.text: Click—

units.displayText: Her unfinished words are drowned out by electronic noise. Sol kicks a piece of debris beside herself. The sound of something hitting the ground comes from up ahead, but no reaction suggests that something was hit.

spans.text: Her unfinished words are drowned out by electronic noise. Sol kicks a piece of debris beside herself. The sound of something hitting the ground comes from up ahead, but no reaction suggests that something was hit.

units.displayText: Most impressive... to think... you sensed my presence...
